description: This Java class defines a ViewHolder for displaying notes in a list within an Android application, specifically for notes without an excerpt. It manages UI elements such as swipe actions, category, status, favorite indicator, and search highlighting.

classes.name: NoteViewHolderWithoutExcerpt
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying notes without excerpts in a RecyclerView, handling UI updates and swipe actions.

methods.name: NoteViewHolderWithoutExcerpt
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with binding and click listener.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Displays swipe options, toggling visibility and background based on swipe direction.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to UI elements, including category, status, favorite, and search query highlighting.
